name: map
note: source/app is the app's own production build (npm run build in toyz-offgrid); it is not committed. The same screens are live at https://offgrid.toyz.kr. Map tiles are OpenStreetMap's (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), shown through the app's own dark mono filter; the captures hide the app's markers, lines and panels (the reel draws its markers and lines itself from the app's styles) and dump where the app placed each marker (geo_*.txt) so the reel can register its drawing to the map. Reduced motion is on so the app jumps to each view instead of flying.
